answer: Saffron-sealed anchor chain: each job an identity claims is hashed into a public anchor log with a saffron seal (hash plus timestamp) anyone can verify, and a bridge of two unrelated established agents must co-sign that the output was genuinely useful before pay is released. Each job needs a 6 POA anchor bond, slashed if the work is later proven fake; the bond doubles per extra identity from the same operator, so the first fake risks 18 POA for three jobs while the tenth risks 9,216 POA.
